methods.steps: Run iconutil -c iconset input.icns and use the PNG representations in the resulting iconset directory.
methods.limits: Extracts every stored size into the iconset, not one picture.

methods.steps: Use from PIL import Image; Image.open("input.icns").save("output.png").
methods.limits: Its ICNS reader defaults to the largest available representation. Set a supported size before load for another representation.

methods.steps: Add the ICNS on Input; choose PNG on Output and click Convert. No Action is needed for a plain conversion.
methods.limits: XnView's format list marks ICNS as read only, so it works as an input.

methods.steps: Run magick input.jp2 output.jpg.
methods.limits: The installed build must read JP2 and write JPEG; the formats page lists JP2 and JPEG as readable and writable.

methods.steps: Add the JP2 files on Input; choose JPEG on Output and click Convert. No Action is needed for a plain conversion.
methods.limits: XnView's format list shows JPEG 2000 as readable and writable.

methods.steps: Use Add files on Input to select the JPEG; choose BMP as the format on Output and run conversion without extra processing actions.
methods.limits: XnView's format list shows BMP as readable and writable; no Action is needed for a plain conversion.

methods.steps: Run magick input.jpeg output.bmp.
methods.limits: BMP2 and BMP3 writers are documented alternatives to the default bitmap variant when required by a reader.

methods.steps: Use from PIL import Image; Image.open("input.jpeg").save("output.bmp").
methods.limits: Pillow documents BMP writing for 1, L, P and RGB modes.

methods.steps: Run magick input.jpg output.ai.
methods.limits: Writes a raster-based file and does no tracing; the formats page lists AI as readable and writable. Test it in the program that will open it.

methods.steps: Run texconv -pow2 -f BC1_UNORM cat.jpg (Microsoft's example); add -m 1 to remove mipmaps.
methods.limits: The example fits textures to power-of-two sizes with -pow2 and generates all mipmaps by default; the default output type is DDS.

methods.steps: File > Export As, export to DDS, then set Compression and Mipmaps in the DDS dialog.
methods.limits: DDS support is built into GIMP from 2.10.10 (release notes).

methods.steps: Run magick input.jpg output.dds.
methods.limits: The formats page lists DDS as readable and writable with compression defines and mipmaps; inspect the result before delivery.

methods.steps: Run ffmpeg -i input.m2ts -c:v libx264 -c:a aac transfer.mp4.
methods.limits: A new encode rather than stream copy; a copied stream the MP4 cannot hold may be dropped or carried as data. Run locally: exit 0. This does not reproduce every browser quality or scale option.

methods.steps: Choose Open Source and pick the M2TS, select a preset, set the destination with Save As and Browse, then click Start.
methods.limits: HandBrake creates MKV and MP4 files. AVCHD playlists are not fully supported, and opening individual stream files is not reliable where a single stream spans multiple files.

methods.steps: Run ffmpeg -i input.m4a -f ipod -b:a 192k -c:a aac output.m4r.
methods.limits: Re-encodes AAC. The -ss and -t options trim; no device installation is included. Run locally: exit 0, ipod AAC output.

methods.steps: Add File(s), pick a Save to Folder or Output Folder (or Browse), choose M4R in the Output Format drop-down, then click Convert.
methods.limits: NCH lists Windows PC, Mac OS X and Android.

methods.steps: Import the audio from Files, drag it to the far left of the Tracks view and trim it, then open My Songs, tap Share and choose Ringtone.
methods.limits: Ringtones can be up to 30 seconds. Protected songs and songs not downloaded to the iPhone are dimmed and cannot be used.

methods.steps: Run ffmpeg -i input.mp3 -b:a 192k -c:a wmav2 output.wma.
methods.limits: Selects lossy WMA rather than WMA Lossless. Run locally: exit 0, wmav2 in ASF. Playback needs the receiving decoder.

methods.steps: File > Export Audio, then choose WMA (version2) Files (FFmpeg) from the Format drop-down.
methods.limits: FFmpeg is not shipped with Audacity and must be installed separately. The export options offer Mono, Stereo or Custom mapping.

methods.steps: Click Add File(s), pick a Save to Folder or Output Folder (or Browse), set the Output Format drop-down to WMA, then click Convert.
methods.limits: Check the receiving device's supported WMA variants.

methods.steps: Run ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -c:v h263 -s 352x288 -r 12 -c:a aac output.3gp.
methods.limits: The -s option forces the size and can change proportions. This is a desktop example, not the exact browser preset.

methods.steps: Use Add File(s) for the MP4, choose a folder with Save to Folder, Output Folder or Browse, set Output Format to 3GP, then click Convert.
methods.limits: The page lists MP4 among formats converted to and from 3GP.

methods.steps: Run MP4Box -add input.mp4 -new output.3gp.
methods.limits: The .3gp extension turns on 3GPP rewriting and some tracks may be removed. This does not transcode.

methods.steps: Run ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -an -c:v libx265 -f hevc output.hevc.
methods.limits: Needs libx265 in the installed build; writes raw video without audio.

methods.steps: Run ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -an -pix_fmt yuv420p intermediate.y4m, then x265 intermediate.y4m output.hevc.
methods.limits: x265 reads raw YUV or Y4M, not MP4 directly. The intermediate needs disk space; sound is excluded.

methods.steps: Inspect MP4Box -info input.mp4, then use MP4Box -raw 1:output=output.hevc input.mp4 with 1 replaced by the verified HEVC track ID.
methods.limits: Only applies when the input already contains a HEVC track. Extraction is not encoding.

icns.fact: Apple documents standard and high-resolution icon resources and iconutil extraction into iconset directories.

jp2.fact: JP2 is the JPEG 2000 Part 1 wrapper and can carry opacity and profile metadata. Its media type is image/jp2.
JPEG 2000 has both lossy and lossless coding modes.

bmp.fact: Windows bitmap headers describe pixel dimensions, bit depth, color tables and possible compression.

jpg.fact: Common JPEG is a lossy raster encoding; it cannot reconstruct detail discarded in a previous encode.
The registered JPEG media type is image/jpeg.
The JPEG committee established the standard through work begun in 1986; the core technology includes the familiar lossy DCT photographic coding.

ai.fact: AI saving can include a PDF representation and linked images; that is distinct from tracing.
Image Trace interprets raster art to produce editable vector artwork.

dds.fact: DDS supports several pixel and surface organizations including compressed data and mipmaps.

m2ts.fact: M2TS modifies MPEG-2 transport streams for BDAV/AVCHD and can have associated folder/playlist structures.

m4r.fact: NCH documents .m4r writing on Windows and identifies ringtone-oriented output in its manual.

wma.fact: Windows Media Audio is a codec family including a distinct lossless member.

3gp.fact: 3GPP audiovisual files belong to the ISO media format family and have video/3gpp and audio/3gpp media types.

hevc.fact: H.265 is High Efficiency Video Coding; raw HEVC output is separate from a multi-track container.
Raw-video muxers cannot store a general audio/video presentation.
